official.deadline_central_display: December 2, 2025 at 4:00 p.m. (EST) - submission of the application to FRQ by preselected candidates (2026-2027 competition)
official.deadline_note: Two-stage timing: preselection by universities/CCTT Network was due October 23, 2025 at 4 p.m.; candidates preselected by the China Scholarship Council had until March 31, 2026; the preselected candidate's own FRQ submission deadline was December 2, 2025 at 4 p.m. The 2026-2027 rules are marked out of competition and no next-cycle dates are published as at 2026-10-10.
official.application_cycle: 2026-2027 (rules apply to the 2026-2027 fiscal year; page marked out of competition)
official.status_note: The published 2026-2027 rules state 'These program rules are out of competition' - the December 2, 2025 deadline and the preselection dates have all passed, results were announced at the end of April 2026, and no 2027-2028 cycle dates are published on the FRQ site as at 10 October 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: In addition to the scholarship, MES offers all scholarship recipients an exemption from paying the higher tuition fees required for foreign students and the medical insurance coverage offered by the Regie de l'assurance maladie du Quebec (RAMQ).
benefits: Master's research scholarship (VM): annual value $20,000, maximum 6 instalments (6 semesters) totalling $40,000
Doctoral research scholarship (V1, 1B, 1C, 1I, 1IS, 1W): $25,000 per year for the first 9 sessions, $12,000 for the last 3 sessions if an extension is requested, maximum 12 sessions totalling $87,000
Short-term research or professional development scholarship (V3, 3B, 3C, 3I, 3IS, 3W): $3,000 per month, maximum 4 instalments totalling $12,000
Exemption from the higher tuition fees charged to foreign students in Quebec and exemption from RAMQ medical insurance coverage costs
Five country-specific bilateral components: Quebec-Brazil, Quebec-China, Quebec-India, Quebec-Israel and Quebec-Wallonia
eligibility: Not a Canadian citizen or permanent resident of Canada, and not having applied for permanent residence under Canadian immigration laws
Preselected by a Quebec university or the CCTT network (or by the China Scholarship Council for the Quebec-China component)

Master's research component: the programme must lead to the writing of a thesis - essays, research reports, dissertations and papers are not accepted, and professional master's programmes are not eligible; up to three full-time semesters (1 year) or less of enrolment before May 1, 2026
Doctoral research component: eligible for the first nine semesters of doctoral study, with all prior doctoral semesters subtracted

Postdoctoral component: PhD obtained no more than two years before the competition deadline, or doctoral dissertation submitted by January 15, 2026; research must be in an institution other than the one that granted the doctorate, and prior doctoral supervisors may not act as postdoctoral supervisor

Short-term component: technical and university students (option A) or researchers who completed a doctorate no more than five years before the deadline (option B); research must be in an institution other than the one at which the student was enrolled when they applied
Must not have already received a Merit Scholarship for Foreign Students from the Ministere de l'Enseignement superieur
Quebec-Wallonia candidates must have previously studied in a French-language university-level institution in Belgium
Recipients must be physically present in Quebec for the entire funding period and attend the institution at which they were preselected; joint (cotutelle) degree programmes are not eligible
requirements: Create an account in the FRQnet system once preselected; FRQ contacts all preselected candidates to complete an electronic form with the required documents attached
Submit electronically by the competition deadline - an application submitted after the deadline is deemed inadmissible by the Fonds
Attach all required documents, which cannot be updated after the application deadline
Notify FRQ of acceptance or refusal of a funding offer no later than 30 days after notification via the FRQnet portal
Documents submitted in a language other than French or English must be accompanied by a basic translation
documents: Photocopy of the identification page of a passport from the candidate's country of origin or any other official document establishing citizenship

Transcripts for every year of all university studies, whether completed or not, organized chronologically from newest to oldest; transcripts from outside North America require a letter explaining the grading system
Acknowledgements of receipt from the publisher for all articles submitted and notices received from editors for articles accepted for publication

Master's/Doctoral components: if applicable, an attestation from the registrar's office identifying part-time or unregistered semesters, and an official attestation of interrupted enrolment with a medical certificate if necessary

Postdoctoral component: a copy of the doctoral diploma (or attestation of the first reading of the dissertation, or the doctoral transcript) plus a letter of acceptance from the supervisor submitted by the supervisor through the FRQnet portal
Short-term component: a letter of acceptance from the supervisor submitted through the FRQnet portal
selection_criteria: Two-stage process: university/CCTT/CSC preselection, then FRQ evaluation by multidisciplinary committees of professors and researchers based on the excellence of the applications
Applications are assessed according to the published evaluation criteria and weighting set out in the programme rules
Scholarships are offered according to the availability of funds; all decisions are final and cannot be subject to appeal, and there is no review process
coverage: Master's research scholarship (VM): $20,000 per year, maximum $40,000 over 6 instalments
Doctoral research scholarship: $25,000 per year for the first 9 sessions and $12,000 for the last 3 if an extension is requested, maximum $87,000 over 12 sessions
Postdoctoral scholarship: $35,000 paid in 3 instalments over one year
Short-term research or professional development scholarship: $3,000 per month, maximum 4 instalments totalling $12,000
Exemption from paying the higher tuition fees required for foreign students in Quebec
Exemption from RAMQ medical insurance coverage costs
application_method: Secure preselection: universities and the CCTT network transmit their nominations through the FRQnet system (due October 23, 2025 at 4 p.m. for the 2026-2027 cycle)
Once preselected, create an account in the FRQnet system and complete the electronic form FRQ sends you, attaching all required documents
Submit electronically before the competition deadline (December 2, 2025 at 4 p.m. for the 2026-2027 cycle)
For the postdoctoral and short-term components, the supervisor submits the letter of acceptance directly through the FRQnet portal
official.application_route: University or CCTT/CSC preselection first, then the FRQnet electronic form completed by the preselected candidate and submitted to the Fonds by the published deadline.
official.study_mode: Full-time dedication to the programme of study, research or professional development for which the scholarship is awarded
official.citizenship_residency: Open to candidates who are not Canadian citizens or permanent residents of Canada and who have not applied for permanent residence under Canadian immigration laws; recipients must be physically present in Quebec throughout the funding period
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the programme is intended for foreign students and researchers from all countries and all research sectors; no research sector is given preference
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: None at programme level (health, humanities and social sciences, arts and letters, natural sciences and engineering all eligible); Quebec-Wallonia candidates must have previously studied in a French-language university-level institution in Belgium
official.research_requirement: Master's component must lead to the writing of a thesis; professional master's programmes are not eligible
official.duration: Master's: maximum 6 instalments (6 semesters). Doctoral: maximum 12 sessions, $25,000 for the first 9 and $12,000 for the last 3 if an extension is requested. Postdoctoral: maximum 12 months, not renewable. Short-term: four months, not renewable.
official.description: In support of the Quebec government's science policy, the Merit Scholarship for Foreign Students program supports the internationalization of research activities in Quebec higher education institutions, attracts top foreign researchers and students, and creates cultural links for joint scientific research projects. It is managed by the Fonds de recherche du Quebec - secteur Nature et technologies, commissioned by the Ministere de l'Enseignement superieur du Quebec, which provides the funding, and comprises master's research, doctoral research, postdoctoral and short-term components plus five bilateral country components.
official.program_type: Merit scholarship programme for foreign students administered by the Fonds de recherche du Quebec for the Ministere de l'Enseignement superieur du Quebec

applicant_utility.summary: The PBEEE is a two-stage funnel and the first stage is the real gate: only candidates preselected by a Quebec university, the CCTT network or the China Scholarship Council can even open the FRQ application, and each university may recommend a maximum of 16 all-countries candidates spread across the four components. Target the university preselection competition in early autumn - for the 2026-2027 round that was October 23, 2025 - and ask your prospective supervisor to plan for the supervisor acceptance letter, which the supervisor must submit personally through FRQnet. Payments only begin once the Fonds has your study permit (doctoral) or work permit (postdoctoral), so budget for your first months in Quebec from your own funds.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Non-Canadian thesis-based master's, doctoral and postdoctoral researchers who have already attracted a Quebec supervisor and can win their university's limited preselection slot.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure a supervisor and the university's preselection decision first - self-submission to FRQ is impossible
Check the component rules against your own history: completed semesters are subtracted from the eligibility period, and prior PBEEE recipients are excluded
Assemble transcripts for every year of all university studies, newest to oldest, with a grading-system letter if your transcripts are from outside North America
Brief your supervisor early: the acceptance letter must be submitted by the supervisor through FRQnet, and an applicant may never submit it on their behalf
Prepare translations where documents are not in French or English
common_rejection_risks: Missing the university preselection date, which no later FRQ submission can repair
Applying to a professional or non-thesis master's programme - only programmes leading to a thesis qualify
Late Fonds submission: anything after the deadline is deemed inadmissible, and uploaded files cannot be updated afterwards
A supervisor letter uploaded by the applicant rather than submitted by the supervisor through the portal, which voids the document
Planning a cotutelle (joint) degree, which is not eligible, or leaving Quebec mid-funding, since physical presence is required throughout
Already holding another government or Quebec grant-agency scholarship - concurrent holding is prohibited
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The scholarship is a fixed annual value (for example $20,000 per year at master's level, $25,000 at doctoral level) plus exemption from the foreign-student tuition surcharge and RAMQ insurance; regular Quebec tuition still applies and the official page does not present the award as covering all living or travel costs.
document_audit: Transcripts must cover every year of every university programme, completed or not, and be ordered newest to oldest - gaps are a common eligibility challenge
For transcripts from outside North America, an extra letter explaining the grading system is mandatory
Publisher acknowledgements are required for submitted articles and editor notices for accepted ones - start collecting these months in advance
The postdoctoral and short-term supervisor acceptance letters travel through the supervisor's own FRQnet access, so confirm your supervisor's portal details well before the deadline
alerts: Scholarship payments start only after the Fonds receives a copy of your study permit (doctoral) or work permit (postdoctoral)
The scholarship period must begin between May 1 and January 15 and cannot be carried over or delayed beyond that window
The 2026-2027 rules are marked out of competition and no next-cycle dates are published yet - watch the FRQ open competitions page rather than relying on dated third-party listings
A refused funding offer cannot be reactivated, and you must respond within 30 days of notification
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: University/CCTT/CSC preselection first, then FRQnet account creation and the electronic form with documents attached, submitted by the Fonds' deadline; FRQ verifies eligibility by December and evaluation committees rank the preselected candidates.
